description: This file contains tests and a custom reporter implementation for Playwright's test framework, focusing on detailed step and error reporting within test suites.

classes.name: MyReporter
classes.description: A custom Playwright Reporter class that formats and reports test steps, errors, and stack traces with indentation and location information.

methods.name: formatPrefix
methods.description: Formats the prefix for log lines with padding.

methods.name: formatLocation
methods.description: Formats the location of a test step or error with filename and line number.

methods.name: formatStack
methods.description: Formats the stack trace, filtering internal frames and formatting for indentation.

methods.name: printErrorLocation
methods.description: Boolean property controlling whether to print error location info.

methods.name: skipErrorMessage
methods.description: Boolean property controlling whether to suppress detailed error messages.

methods.name: printStep
methods.description: Recursively prints test steps, handling nested steps, annotations, errors, and stack traces.

methods.name: onBegin
methods.description: Handles initialization at the start of the test suite.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Handles reporting at the end of test suite execution, printing nested suite and test results.
